edges.subject: CLN6
edges.quote: CLN6 encodes a resident-ER protein involved in trafficking lysosomal proteins to the Golgi.

edges.subject: CLN6
edges.quote: CLN6p deficiency results in lysosomal dysfunction and deposition of storage material comprised of Nile Red + lipids/proteolipids that include subunit C of the mitochondrial ATP synthase (SUBC).

edges.subject: CLN6 disease
edges.quote: Several CLN6 subjects had neuroimaging consistent with leukodystrophy.
